headline: Glanbia Shares Drop 6% Following Morgan Stanley Downgrade
summary: Shares of Irish nutrition company Glanbia fell 6% after Morgan Stanley lowered its rating on the stock to underweight.
why: Glanbia plc is an international sports nutrition and dairy ingredients group listed on the Irish and London stock exchanges.

impacts.name: Glanbia plc
impacts.why: Morgan Stanley downgraded the stock to underweight, prompting institutional selling.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
